primitives.name: Shrinkage Completion Surface
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Individual/team surfaces:** 2-D Naive Bayes estimate that shrinks group surfaces toward the league surface.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'N_g': 'number of passes for group g (dimensionless)', 'N_Median': 'median number of passes across groups (dimensionless)', 'f̂_g(x,y)': '2D kernel density estimate of pass locations for group g (yards⁻²)', 'f̂_NFL(x,y)': '2D kernel density estimate of league pass locations (yards⁻²)', 'P̂_g(Complete|x,y)': 'raw completion probability for group g at location (x,y) (dimensionless)', 'P̂_NFL(Complete|x,y)': 'league-wide completion probability at location (x,y) (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Pass locations follow a smooth spatial distribution; completion rates vary smoothly with position; shrinkage weights data-driven via empirical Bayes.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When N_g < N_Median, prior (league) dominates; when N_g >> N_Median, data dominates.

layer2.mapping: The shrinkage surface maps to a Bayesian posterior distribution over completion probabilities, where group-specific estimates are regularized toward a global prior.
layer2.telemetry: Correlation between computed and official NGS CPAE values.

primitives.name: Spatial Density Weighted Integral
primitives.verbatim_quote: **CPAE_g:** spatial-density-weighted integral of the group's above-league-average completion surface (equation (1) in paper; see §4).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'CPAE_g': 'Completion Probability Above League Expectation for group g (percentage points)', 'P̂*_{g,league}(Complete|x,y)': 'Group-adjusted completion probability relative to league average (dimensionless)', 'f̂_g(x,y)': 'Spatial density of pass attempts for group g (yards⁻²)'}
primitives.assumptions: Above-leverage completion surface integrates meaningfully over spatial domain; spatial density accurately reflects attempt frequency.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Integral becomes unstable if f̂_g(x,y) is sparse or highly variable.

layer2.mapping: The integral computes a scalar summary statistic of deviation from league expectation, weighted by spatial attempt density.
layer2.telemetry: Pearson correlation coefficient with official NGS CPAE.

primitives.name: Computer Vision Pass Extraction
primitives.verbatim_quote: **next-gen-scraPy image pipeline:** computer-vision module processes NGS pass-chart images → K-Means++ clustering to identify passes and field locations (relative to LOS) → DBSCAN to remove noise from segmented images.
primitives.assumptions: Pass chart images contain sufficient visual cues for segmentation; K-Means++ and DBSCAN provide robust clustering and denoising.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs with low image quality or ambiguous visual features.

layer2.mapping: Image processing pipeline mirrors a feature extraction operator mapping raw pixels to structured pass coordinates.
layer2.telemetry: Coordinate accuracy validated against Big Data Bowl tracking data.

The core innovation lies in reconstructing NFL’s proprietary CPAE metric using publicly available pass-chart images. The method begins with a computer vision pipeline extracting pass coordinates from static images, followed by a generalized additive model (GAM) to estimate league-wide completion probabilities as smooth functions of spatial location. These estimates are then shrunk toward the league average using empirical Bayes Naive Bayes, producing individual or team-level surfaces. The final step integrates these adjusted surfaces over spatial density to compute CPAE—a scalar measure of above-average completion rate. This approach leverages statistical smoothing, regularization, and spatial weighting to approximate complex tracking data without direct access to it. Dualities emerge in how spatial density acts both as a weighting mechanism and a proxy for sample size. Failure modes include poor image quality, insufficient data per group, and misalignment between scraped and tracking datasets. Temporal stability is assessed through correlations between years, revealing moderate consistency despite lack of temporal trends in the scraped version.
